list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Fed from kube-state-metrics, never from process_start_time_seconds: postgresql is minReplicaCount 0, so a process-lifecycle metric leaves this variable — and every panel, including the backlog and KEDA rows that survive the sleeping pod — empty in the connector's normal state.

list.name: pod
list.label: Pod
list.description: allValue is .+ and not .*: where a PodMonitor and a Service-level catch-all scrape the same target, only the PodMonitor copy carries a pod label. In PromQL .* also matches the absent label, which doubles every additive aggregation while leaving percentiles and _sum/_count ratios correct.

options.content:
**Totals add up every scan in the time range.** Two scans of a 139-table server read 278 tables. To count what the server holds, narrow the range to one scan.

**Bars and stats say _how many_. The line charts beside them say _when_.** A scan shorter than ~30 seconds can be invisible on a line chart and still be fully counted in the bars.

**One item = one column.** PostgreSQL sends no table documents, so Items Sent should equal Columns Found exactly.

**What this board cannot tell you:** anything per datasource, per database or per schema (the metrics carry none of those labels — the dead-letter messages and the logs do name them); how many connections PostgreSQL is holding (nothing measures it); and how long a scan took end to end (nothing times it: 'Scan Duration' is read off the first and last activity, ±15 s).

Hover the ⓘ on any panel for what it counts, what is normal, and where to look next.

panels.title: Duration ±15s
panels.description:
**How long the scan took, end to end**: from the moment its databases were listed to the last table read. With several scans in the range it spans all of them, idle gaps included.

**Normal:** seconds to minutes, precise to about ±15 s: it is read from samples taken every 10–30 s, not timed. **0 s means the whole scan fit between two samples** — it ran and was fast (a 144-table server scans in about a second); the counts beside it show what it did.

**Next:** 'Fan-out over time' in the Scanner row shows the same span as a shape.

targets.expr: max_over_time(timestamp(sum(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)) > 0)[$__range:15s]) - min_over_time(timestamp(sum(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_databases_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_databases_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_databases_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)) > 0)[$__range:15s])

panels.title: Databases
panels.description:
**Databases the scan found on the server** and handed out to be scanned, after the configured exclusions.

**Normal:** the number of databases the scan account can see, once per scan in the range.

**Next:** 'Database Failures' in Scan Health for the ones that could not be opened.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_databases_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_databases_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_databases_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Schemas
panels.description:
**Schemas found across those databases**, system schemas excluded.

**Normal:** the user schemas of every scanned database.

**Next:** 'Schemas by Scan Mode' in the funnel for how each one was read.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_schemas_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_schemas_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_schemas_discovered_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Tables
panels.description:
**Tables, views, materialized views and foreign tables whose columns were read.**

**Normal:** every relation of every scanned schema. A relation with no columns is skipped in bulk mode and counted in table mode.

**Next:** 'Tables by Outcome' in the funnel.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Columns
panels.description:
**Columns read across all scanned tables.** Each one becomes one item.

**Normal:** roughly tables × average width ('Columns per Table' on the Pipeline board).

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Items Sent
panels.description:
**Items handed to the sender for indexing**, one per column. Counted when queued: a batch that then fails to reach the message queue is not subtracted.

**Normal:** exactly Columns Found.

**Next:** 'Items Lost' beside it.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Items Lost
panels.description:
**Columns found but never handed on for indexing**: Columns Found minus Items Sent.

**Normal:** 0. Above 0 means those columns are missing from the index while the scan still finishes green.

**Next:** 'Columns Lost' in Scan Health, and the scanner logs ('buildDocuments', 'Failed to upsert item').

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0)) - ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Fetches
panels.description:
**Column samples requested from the content side**, any outcome. Content runs on its own pods, triggered separately from scans.

**Normal:** whatever the downstream classifier asked for; 0 when nothing requested samples.

**Next:** the Content row.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_content_fetch_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go-content"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_content_fetch_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go-content"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_content_fetch_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go-content"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Funnel — Database → Schema → Table → Column → Item
Schema Attempts
panels.description:
**Times a schema was read — attempts, not schemas.** A schema that fails temporarily is retried, up to 5 times, and every try counts here.

**Normal:** equal to Schemas Discovered. Above it means schemas are failing and being retried.

**Next:** 'NATS Redelivered' in the Scanner row and 'Work Lost (DLQ)' beside it.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type=~"bulk_tables|tables_in_schema"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type=~"bulk_tables|tables_in_schema"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type=~"bulk_tables|tables_in_schema"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Items per Column
panels.description:
**Does every column found become an item?**

**Normal:** 100%. Lower means items failed to be built or queued — the scan still looks green.

**Next:** 'Items Lost' for how many.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_items_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_columns_found_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0)

panels.title: Batches Published (window)
panels.description:
**Batches of items that actually reached the message queue.** Items are sent 100 at a time, plus one partial batch per schema, so this is roughly Items Sent ÷ 100 + Schemas Discovered.

**Normal:** steady relative to Items Sent. The only trace of a final batch that failed to publish: Items Sent still counts those items, this does not.

**Next:** the scanner logs for 'Failed to flush remaining items'.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(connector_batches_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(connector_batches_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(connector_batches_sent_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Work Lost (DLQ)
panels.description:
**Scan work that failed all 5 attempts and was given up on** in the selected range: a scan request, a whole database or a whole schema — not indexed while the scan reports success.

**Normal:** 0. The board cannot name it; each message in the dead-letter queue does: `nats stream get DLQ_CONSUME_POSTGRESQL <seq>`.

**Next:** the Dead Letter Queue row at the bottom.

panels.title: Schemas by Scan Mode (window)
panels.description:
**How each schema was read** (scan mode auto). Bulk = two queries for the whole schema, used below 10,000 columns (POSTGRESQL_BULK_THRESHOLD). Table mode = one query per table, run in parallel, for bigger schemas — or when counting the schema's columns failed. Counts attempts: a retried schema counts again.

**Normal:** mostly bulk. Neither is a problem; table mode is just slower per column. A sudden jump in table mode on the same server means counting columns is failing and schemas are falling back — most often because the server ran out of connections (see Scan Health).

**Next:** the line chart beside it shows when.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type="bulk_tables"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type="bulk_tables"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type="bulk_tables"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type="tables_in_schema"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type="tables_in_schema"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", query_type="tables_in_schema"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Schemas by Scan Mode (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When schemas were read, by mode**, same colours as the bars beside it.

**Normal:** a bump per scan. A scan shorter than ~30 seconds may not show here at all — the bars still count it.

panels.title: Tables by Outcome (window)
panels.description:
**What happened to every table.** Scanned = its columns were read. Lost = its column query failed (table mode only; in bulk a failure loses the whole schema, see Scan Health). Permissions missing = scanned, but its column permissions could not be read, so its items went out with empty permissions — a subset of scanned.

**Normal:** only green. Orange needs a grant for the scan account; red needs a look at the scanner logs.

**Next:** the line chart beside it shows when.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", scope="table"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", scope="table"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_table_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", scope="table"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_permissions_failed_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_permissions_failed_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_permissions_failed_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Tables by Outcome (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When tables were scanned or lost**, same colours as the bars beside it.

**Normal:** a green bump per scan.

**Next:** the bars beside it for how many.

panels.title: NATS Backlog
panels.description:
**Work waiting in the queue** (stream JE_POSTGRESQL): scan requests, databases and schemas not picked up yet. This is 'how far behind is it?', and it is readable even while the connector is asleep.

**Normal:** 0 between scans. Growing with no pods running means the connector is not waking up.

panels.title: NATS In Flight
panels.description:
**Work handed to a pod and not finished yet.** Each message is a whole database or schema.

**Normal:** a few while a scan runs, 0 otherwise. Stuck above 0 while nothing is being scanned means a pod is hung.

panels.title: NATS Redelivered
panels.description:
**Work being retried after a failure.** A database or schema is retried up to 5 times before going to the dead-letter queue.

**Normal:** 0. A connector failing and retrying in a loop shows up here and nowhere else.

**Next:** Scan Health for what is failing.

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description:
**Scanner pods running now**, as the autoscaler reports them.

**Normal:** 0 between scans, a few during one.

panels.title: Max Replicas
panels.description:
**The most scanner pods the autoscaler may start** (chart setting autoscaling.maxReplicas, 10 by default).

**Normal:** read it against Replicas: at the ceiling with a growing backlog means the scanner cannot go faster.

panels.title: Backlog Slope (2m)
panels.description:
**How fast the backlog is growing**, in messages per second. This is exactly what one of the autoscaler's rules looks at.

**Normal:** 0. Above 0.5 the autoscaler adds pods.

panels.title: NATS — Scanner Consumer Backlog
panels.description:
**The queue over time.** Pending = waiting, ack pending = being worked on, redelivered = being retried. Each message is a scan request, a database or a schema, so 3 pending can be three entire schemas.

**Normal:** spikes at the start of a scan that drain to 0.

panels.title: KEDA — Replicas: current vs desired vs max
panels.description:
**Pods running, pods wanted, and the ceiling.**

**Normal:** pods stay up ~5–10 minutes after the work ends (cooldown 300 s, scale-down window 300 s, at most half the pods removed per minute). 'It scaled minutes ago and is still the same' is configuration, not a bug.

panels.title: Pods Up
panels.description:
**Scanner pods answering right now.**

**Normal:** 0 when idle — the scanner scales to zero between scans. That is not an outage.

panels.title: Restarts (1h)
panels.description:
**Scanner container restarts in the last hour.**

**Normal:** 0. Usually the pod ran out of memory (limit 1 GiB) or failed its health check; the work it held is retried.

**Next:** the Runtime board.

panels.title: Fan-out Mean
panels.description:
**Only the first step of a scan: connecting, listing the databases and queuing them.** It is NOT how long the whole scan took — databases and schemas are scanned afterwards, possibly on other pods.

**Normal:** well under a second.

**Next:** 'Duration ±15s' in Totals for the whole scan.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_scan_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_scan_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0)

panels.title: Peak In Flight /20
panels.description:
**Most tables this pod was reading at the same time.** Up to 10 schemas at once (POSTGRESQL_NATS_WORKERS), and in table mode up to 10 more tables on the worker pool (POSTGRESQL_POOL_WORKERS) — 20 in all.

**Normal:** below 20. Sampled every 10–30 s, so a small scan can read 0 here and still have run.

**Next:** 'Tables In Flight by pod' in the Queries row.

panels.title: Query p95 (window)
panels.description:
**How slow the slowest 5% of the scanner's SQL queries were**, all kinds together.

**Normal:** under a second on a healthy database.

**Next:** 'Query Time by Type' below, and the Pipeline board for each kind.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) >= 0

panels.title: Queries Run (window)
panels.description:
**SQL queries the scanner sent to PostgreSQL**, all kinds.

**Normal:** about 2 per table plus a few per schema: every table gets a permissions query, and in table mode a column query too.

**Next:** 'Query Count by Type' on the Pipeline board.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Scanner Throughput (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**How fast the scanner is working**, while it works.

**Normal:** only meaningful during a long scan; a short one may read 0 here and still be fully counted in the stats above.

panels.title: Fan-out over time (rate, 5m)
panels.description:
**When the scan ran.** Databases are discovered first, then schemas, then tables; the span from the first to the last movement of 'tables scanned' is the closest thing to how long the whole scan took.

**Normal:** three bumps in that order, close together.

panels.title: KEDA — Scanner Trigger Signals
panels.description:
**What the scanner's autoscaler looks at.** ack-capacity = work in progress; trend-based = is the queue growing; pending-wakeup = wakes the scanner from zero on the first queued message.

**Normal:** far below the thresholds in the legend. Note the scale: the trend signal is a rate and is tiny next to the others.

panels.title: Query Time by Type (window)
panels.description:
**Where the scanner spent its database time**: total seconds per kind of query. table_permissions runs once per table in both modes; list_columns once per table in table mode; bulk_tables + bulk_columns once per schema in bulk mode; the rest once per database or schema.

**Normal:** table_permissions or list_columns on top — they run per table. A per-schema query on top means one schema is very large.

**Next:** the Pipeline board has each kind's percentiles and counts.

targets.expr: sum by (query_type) (sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0

panels.title: Tables In Flight by pod
panels.description:
**Tables each pod was reading at once**, highest value in each minute. The red line is the per-pod ceiling (20).

The board cannot show connections to PostgreSQL: nothing measures them. For sizing, each scan opens a pool of up to 20 connections per database it reads, per pod, and closes idle ones after ~2.5 minutes — so many databases or many pods can reach the server's max_connections (100 by default) long before this line reaches 20. Measured locally: 15 concurrent scans of a 7-database server filled 100 connections in 2 seconds — all of them idle, held by the scans' pools — and kept the server full for ~3 minutes; 2 scans and 42 databases ended in the dead-letter queue.

**Normal:** below the line. At the line with a growing backlog means the pod is the bottleneck.

**Next:** pg_stat_activity on the server for the real connection count.

panels.title: Start Failures
panels.description:
**Attempts at starting a scan that failed**: could not connect to the server, verify the connection, or list its databases. Each try counts: the scan request is retried up to 5 times, so one scan that never starts reads 5, and then the whole scan is lost.

**Normal:** 0. Usually wrong host, password or network policy — the scan shows as failed in the UI.

**Next:** the scanner logs ('postgresql.connection.*', 'postgresql.database.list_failed').

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_database_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", scope="server"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_database_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", scope="server"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_database_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go", scope="server"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s]))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Database Failures
panels.description:
**Attempts at reading a database that failed**: its schemas could not be listed. The most common cause is a database the scan account has no CONNECT privilege on — the failure only shows when the first query runs. Each database is retried up to 5 times, so one lost database reads 5 here and 1 in 'Work Lost (DLQ)'.

**Normal:** 0. Any value is an entire database missing from a scan that otherwise finishes.

**Next:** the scan's error list in the UI names the database ('postgresql.schema.list_failed'). Many at once, across several scans, together with Scan Start Failures and a jump in table-mode schemas, is the server refusing connections ('too many clients'): see 'Tables In Flight by pod'.

**Normal:** 0. In bulk mode one lost schema is every one of its tables.

**Next:** 'Errors by What Was Lost' below; the DLQ row if they were retried 5 times.
